N_evaluated: Only after authorized GPU and separate authorized evaluation; do not assign a number before corrected features exist
binary_target: Resolved SIDE_A=1; SIDE_T or SIDE_V=0; use historical outcome resolver/accounting, no ontology mapping
coverage: N evaluated resolved SIDE with finite corrected features / N prespecified frozen eligible conflict rows. Technical missing, OTHER, PARSE_FAIL, same-label and structural unsupported are separately counted; never silently removed from accounting.
feature_missing: Report separately; retain frozen prespecified denominator and additionally report historical feature-finite eligible denominator for comparability.
metrics_undefined: AUROC/BA null with explicit reason if binary outcome classes insufficient

ruling_criteria.SURVIVES_WITH_CORRECTION: Material numerical changes preserve MCR strongest, CA-MER weak/partial, LISTEN unsupported/weak structure
